title: Future Motion Recalls Footpads for Onewheel GT Electric Skateboards Due to Bystander Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The footpad can fail to disengage after the rider has dismounted while the board is in motion and the skateboard can unexpectedly continue to operate, posing an injury hazard to bystanders. Units: About 20,500.

title: Residential Elevators Recalls Home Elevators Due to Child Entrapment Hazard; Risk of Serious Injury or Death to Young Children
summary: Young children can become entrapped in the space between the exterior landing (hoistway) door and the interior elevator car door or gate if there is a hazardous gap and suffer serious injuries or death when the elevator is called to another floor. Units: About 31,000.

title: DeWALT Recalls Nearly 1.4 Million Miter Saws Due to Injury and Laceration Hazards
summary: The miter saw's rear safety guard can break or detach, posing an injury hazard due to projectiles that can strike the user and bystanders and a laceration hazard to the user who could come into direct contact with the saw blade. Units: About 1,364,000 (In addition, about 118,600 were sold in Canada)

title: Makita U.S.A. Recalls Cordless Hedge Trimmers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The teal-colored guard on the recalled hedge trimmer's shear blade is missing, posing a laceration hazard to users. Units: About 2,600.

title: Big Game Hunters Children's Outdoor Kitchens Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban; Imported by DOM Sports; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com
summary: The brass water tap of the play kitchen contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 190.

title: Epoch Everlasting Play Recalls Kidoozie™ Activity Desk Toys Due to Entanglement and Entrapment Hazards
summary: When attached to a crib, a protruding knob on the activity desks can become entangled with clothing on a child, posing an entanglement hazard. The opening in the handle on the desks can also pose a jaw entrapment hazard to children under 18 months. Units: About 8,200 (In addition, about 1,830 were s

title: Huffy Corporation Recalls Ride-On Toys Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The ride-on toy can tip forward when a young child is riding it, posing fall and injury hazards to children. Units: About 28,550.

title: IKEA Recalls METALLISK Espresso Makers Due to Burn and Injury Hazards
summary: The recalled espresso makers with the stainless-steel safety valve can burst and expel hot contents, posing burn or other injury hazards to consumers. Units: About 2,100 (In addition, about 5,200 were sold in Canada and about 200 were sold in Mexico).

title: Paddles Sold with Stand-up Paddleboards Recalled Due to Risk of Puncture or Laceration Hazard; Manufactured by Agit Global
summary: The paddle can suddenly break mid-shaft into two pieces during use, exposing sharp edges and posing a risk of serious injury including puncture or laceration hazards. Units: About 124,000.

title: Polaris Industries Recalls Patriot Boost Snowmobiles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The primary (drive) clutch bolt can break, causing the clutch assembly components to separate, creating a projectile risk and posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,300 (In addition, about 986 were sold in Canada).

title: Steel Rolling Chassis for Utility Vehicles Recalled Due to Crash and Injury Hazards; Imported by Navitas Vehicle Systems
summary: The throttle pedal can stick in the depressed position, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 3,700.

title: Trek Bicycle Corporation Recalls Road Bikes and Bicycle Handlebar/ Stems Due to Fall and Crash Hazards
summary: The bicycle's carbon handlebars can crack, posing fall and crash hazards. Units: About 3,200 bicycles/900 aftermarket handlebar stems (In addition, about 530 bicycles/115 aftermarket handlebar/stems in Canada).

title: ASUS Computer International Recalls ASUS ROG Maximus Z690 Hero Motherboards Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: A capacitor on the motherboard was installed in a reverse position which can lead to a short circuit, overheating or melting, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 10,000.

title: Hard Rock Recalls Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The children's sweatshirts have a drawstring in the hood that can become entangled or caught on objects, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 1,550.

title: 4moms Recalls More than 2 Million MamaRoo and RockaRoo Infant Swings and Rockers Due to Entanglement and Strangulation Hazards; One Death Reported
summary: When the swing or rocker is not in use, their restraint straps can dangle below the seat and non-occupant crawling infants can become entangled in the straps, posing a strangulation hazard.
